text:
alex: Quick sync — planning handover for marketplace onramp. Need a single checklist that covers HW slotting, kernel compat, SI handoff, and co-marketing embargo windows :calendar: 

mira: +1. We should lock H100/H200 and MI300 availability windows first. any hard dates from vendor?

kwon_vendor: H100 shipments to partners start week of May 12. H200 is still TBD (internal qual next week). MI300 pilot racks available May 26. No GA date yet for Gaudi until perf signoff.

sam: thanks @kwon_vendor. Can you confirm shipping qty for initial SI wave? we need rack IDs for lab booking.

kwon_vendor: Initial SI wave: 8 H100 nodes, 6 MI300 nodes, 4 B200 units. Rack IDs will be sent by EOD Friday.

gina: note: marketplace listing needs SKU mapping + image tags. I'll own the SKU matrix. Need kernel/test matrix from eng-runtime by Monday.

alex: gina -> please include quantized model variants and recommended runtime configs (batching, kv-cache). Also include fallback model tokens for latency SLOs.

mira: ops ask — define embargo window for joint announcement. Vendors prefer a 72h notice before public GA. Can we carve a 2-week internal embargo for docs & marketplace copy?

kwon_vendor: 72h is our legal minimum. 2-week preannounce for marketing assets is fine. We'll request an embargo lift date by May 20.

sam: engineering checklist (pre-SI handoff):
- validate kernel build on H100/H200/MI300
- run perf harness (p95, p99) across sequences: 128, 512
- run quantized inference flows (int8/4bit)
- smoke test model rollbacks and canary routing
- confirm autoscale policy in dedicated env
(putting more detailed commands below)

sam: code snippet for perf harness:
```
ssh build@lab "./run_perf --gpus H100,MI300 --seqs 128,512 --iters 1000 --save results.json"
```

gina: that'll feed my marketplace metrics table. Also include preferred AMI/container tags for private deployments.

alex: who's owning SI runbook and on-call for first 48h after handoff?

mira: i'll take runbook authoring. sam, can you be primary on-call first 48h? gina will be backup for marketplace rollback.

sam: can do. i'll set a PagerDuty schedule and post in eng-oncall channel.

deploy-bot: Reminder: lab booking for rack 7H reserved May 13-20 (auto-notify 48h before).

kwon_vendor: sending rack IDs and shipping manifests by Friday. Also pushing board-level BIOS patches next week — expect a kernel ABI checkpoint required.

sam: important — BIOS patches probably mean rebuild kernel images. I'll schedule a CI matrix job: linux-compat/H100-H200-MI300.

gina: marketing timeline draft: 
- May 20: embargo lift request to partners
- May 22: internal ops dry run
- May 26: SI onramp starts (pilot customers)
- June 9: tentative marketplace listing (dependent on GA and vendor availability)

alex: action items summary: 
- @kwon_vendor send rack IDs + manifest (due Fri)
- @sam create CI linux-compat job and set oncall (due Mon)
- @gina SKU matrix + AMI/container tags (due Mon)
- @mira author runbook + embargo coord (due Tue)

mira: i'm adding a short checklist to the partnership drive and will ping this thread when done.

kwon_vendor: acknowledged. will share dates for H200 once qual completes.

alex: perfect. if anything slips, call it out early. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
